coordinateSystem: Original body-fixed radar-model Cartesian axes; positive Z is the selected spin pole; east-positive longitude; arbitrary display phase
source: Busch et al. (2007), Icarus 190, 608–621; Arecibo, Goldstone and NASA/JPL radar astronomy: ecliptic J2000 lambda 187.4 deg, beta -89.5 deg, period 2.1216 h; equatorial conversion uses J2000 obliquity 23.439291111 deg. This view uses the published 2007 retrograde reconstruction. The 2014 Yarkovsky analysis rules out the prograde alternative. About 30% of the retrograde model surface was unseen or seen at incidence angles above 75 degrees in the original observations, so that region depends on the model assumptions. No optical surface map is supplied.
